loom_video_outreach.overview: Personalized Loom videos get 3x higher reply rates than text-only emails. Cost: $15/mo for Loom Pro. Record 20-30 per day in 2-3 hours.

scripts.name: CRM Reactivation - Website Walkthrough
script: [SCREEN: Their website homepage]
Hey {{first_name}}, Dylan here from Realside AI.
[SCREEN: Show their Google reviews or website with phone number visible]
I was looking at {{company_name}} and noticed you guys are doing great work in {{industry}} in {{location}}.
[SCREEN: Switch to a simple slide showing 'Problem: 80% of CRM leads go unworked']
Quick question — how many leads are sitting in your CRM right now that nobody's followed up with in the last 6 months?
For most {{industry}} companies we work with, it's thousands. And you already paid to get those leads.
[SCREEN: Show a quick dashboard/result screenshot]
We built an AI agent that goes through your entire database, re-engages those cold leads, and books the warm ones as appointments on your calendar.
One of our {{industry}} clients reactivated 15% of their dead database in the first month — that was over 40 booked appointments from leads they'd given up on.
[SCREEN: Calendly link]
If that sounds interesting, I dropped a link below to grab 15 minutes. Would love to show you the numbers specific to {{company_name}}.
Either way, keep crushing it. Talk soon.

scripts.name: Voice Agent - Call Their Business
script: [SCREEN: Your phone/dialer showing their business number]
Hey {{first_name}}, Dylan here. I did something kind of bold — I called {{company_name}} at 7pm last night just to see what would happen.
[SCREEN: Show what happened - voicemail? Hold music? No answer?]
And it went straight to voicemail. Which means if I was a real customer looking for a {{industry}} company... I'm probably calling your competitor next.
[SCREEN: Simple stat slide - '78% of customers go with whoever answers first']
We built an AI phone agent that answers every call in under 2 seconds — 24/7. It sounds natural, qualifies the caller, and books appointments on your calendar.
[SCREEN: Show a quick demo clip or dashboard]
One of our clients picked up 47 calls in their first month that they would have missed. 19 of those became appointments.
[SCREEN: Calendly link]
Grabbed a link below if you want to see a quick demo — takes 15 minutes.
And no shade on the voicemail thing — everyone's dealing with it. We just have a fix for it now.
scripts.send_via: Email or LinkedIn DM (highest impact script — creates urgency)

best_practices: Record in batches of 10 — same vertical, switch first names and companies
Always have their website open on screen (shows you did research)
Keep under 60 seconds — drop-off skyrockets after that
Use Loom's CTA button feature to embed your Calendly link
Thumbnail: You pointing at their website with an expressive face
Send videos Tue-Thu 8-10am for highest open rates
Track views in Loom — follow up with anyone who watched >75%

daily_workflow.step_1: Pull 20-30 contacts from today's target vertical
daily_workflow.step_2: Open each company's website in a tab
daily_workflow.step_3: Record videos in batches (5 at a time, same script, swap names)
daily_workflow.step_4: Send via email with subject: 'Made a quick video for {{company_name}}'
daily_workflow.step_5: Also send via LinkedIn DM if connected
daily_workflow.step_6: Next day: Check Loom analytics, follow up with viewers
